Select distinct molecule chembl_id aliased as compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles from compound_structures. Join molecule_dictionary on molregno for the chembl_id. Join activities on molregno, then assays on assay_id, then target_dictionary on tid. Filter target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1827' and assays.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens'. Sort by compound_chembl_id then canonical_smiles.
